$comment: Reserved QA key-attribute catalogue. Authority: docs/test-data-catalogue.md. Grammar guard: tests/selftest/reference-catalogue.spec.ts. Every value here is pre-seeded reference data uploaded through the yieldWerx desktop STDF/ATDF dialog — it is NOT created at runtime.

shared.$comment: Facility and Work Center are NOT scope levels (spec Q-05 / OOS-12) — they are Data Selection UI fields, so they carry no feature code and are shared by every feature forever.

seedState.$comment: Observed 2026-08-04 by UI Recon against http://localhost:5173/ml-yield (API-verified via GET /common/scopeNodes). 'absent' values are DEFINED by this catalogue but NOT YET SEEDED — cases may reference them, but they cannot be executed until the upload is performed.

blocks.TC-cluster-detection-080: multi-value scope selection needs a second value at some level
blocks.engine-cases: seeded wafer 1 carries exactly ONE hard-bin-5 die; adjacency cases need >= 3 adjacent bin-5 dies

seedingRunbook.$comment: One upload per row through the desktop 'View and Update Data File Key Attributes' dialog. Vary exactly ONE axis per row so a case can attribute a scope miss to a single field. Lot ID and Wafer ID are NOT retained by the dialog's reference checkbox — re-enter them per file.

rows.purpose: multi-wafer lot for Lot-level scope and aggregation

retired.$comment: Pre-catalogue literals. UI Recon 2026-08-04 confirmed none of these exist in the application any more. The grammar guard fails the build if any reappears in features/.
